notes.title: Nintendo Switch version is coming in February!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we are happy to announce that Kingdom of Corrupts is coming to #NintendoSwitch in February.

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.notes:
Everything completely changed based on user experience and community feedback.
Main changes are:


Overall level design and art improved.
Resolution increased to 1280x720.
Sound vfx and Musics are added.
Adjusted complete scenario.
Save&Load.
All archievements updated.
Polished ambience.
And many more.
